title: Online model: shell feedback (shown/accepted)
description: Log suggestion impressions and infer accept/reject to support online calibration and evaluation.
design:
Extend zsh integration to track what suggestion was last shown and when.

Mechanism (zsh)
- When _zsh_autosuggest_strategy_zage computes suggestion, store _ZAGE_LAST_SUGGESTION + _ZAGE_LAST_SUGGESTION_AT.
- In preexec, compare executing command to last suggestion within a short window; if equal, emit feedback=accepted.
- Optionally emit weak negative when a suggestion was shown but a different command executed soon after (guarded to reduce noise).

Plumbing
- Add a CLI/Request endpoint to accept feedback events and store in online_feedback table.
- Use these events to learn α/β/γ/δ (or at least α) and measure acceptance rate proxy.
acceptance_criteria:
Correctness
- Never logs raw secrets beyond what already exists in shell_history; follow existing privacy posture.
- Feedback logging must not block shell UX (best-effort, background).

Tests
- Unit test for feedback event parsing/validation.
- Integration test: simulate feedback request roundtrip in daemon tests.
- `mise test` passes.

title: Online model: generalized tokens + subword hashing
description: Implement the stable command/context representations used by the online learner (generalized tokens + FastText-style subword hashing).
design:
Implement feature extraction module that produces:
- command tokens: head:<cmd>, flag:<flag> (sorted+dedup), arg:<normalized> (bounded)
- context tokens: ctx:workspace_root, ctx:cwd, ctx:exit, ctx:host, ctx:user, ctx:timebucket, ctx:session
- window tokens: prevN:head/flag/arg (or prev:...) for last N commands

Implement char n-grams (3..=6) on token strings, hashed into fixed buckets (2^17) with sign hashing.

Keep it deterministic and cheap; no allocations in hot path if possible.
acceptance_criteria:
Correctness
- Tokenization matches doc invariants (flags position-independent, args normalized, bounded).
- Hashing is stable across runs/hosts (uses stable hash).

Performance
- Feature extraction for one record is <~1ms on typical command lines.

Tests
- Unit tests for tokenization invariants (flag ordering/dedup, arg normalization).
- Unit tests for n-gram hashing bucket+sign determinism.
- Golden tests for a handful of real commands.
- `mise test` passes.

title: Online model: DB schema + reset
description: Add durable storage for the online next-command model (embeddings, scalars, replay, calibration) and safe reset paths.
design:
Add new tables via src/db/schema-v0.sql + ensure_* upgrade helpers in src/db.rs:init.

Tables (initial proposal)
- online_token_embedding(bucket INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, vec BLOB, opt_state BLOB, updated_at)
- online_command_bias(command TEXT PRIMARY KEY, bias REAL, updated_at) [optional v1]
- online_head_bias(head TEXT PRIMARY KEY, bias REAL, updated_at) [optional v1]
- online_group_scalar(group TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value REAL, updated_at)
- online_replay_global(event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, payload BLOB, sampled_at)
- online_replay_workspace(workspace_root TEXT, seq INTEGER, payload BLOB, PRIMARY KEY(workspace_root, seq))
- online_feedback(shown_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, shown_at, workspace_root, cwd, prefix, suggestion, accepted_command, accepted_at, outcome)
- online_model_meta(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT)

Needs careful migration semantics: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + ALTER TABLE for additive columns.
acceptance_criteria:
Schema
- Fresh DB init creates all tables.
- Existing DB upgrades idempotently (no data loss).

Ops
- Add a CLI or request path to reset online model state (tables cleared) without touching shell_history/stats.

Tests
- Unit test: init() creates tables on empty DB.
- Unit test: init() upgrades when tables missing.
- Roundtrip test: reset clears only online tables.
- `mise test` passes.

title: Online model: config + observability
description: Expose feature flags, model status, and basic counters so we can run the online model safely.
design:
Add config knobs (env/config) for D/K/window, bucket count, replay sizing, gates, and blend weights.

Surface

- Status output clearly reports whether online scoring is active and whether the model has warmed up.

title: Online model: ranking integration (gating + blending)
description: Integrate online model scoring into the suggest pipeline with confidence gating and calibrated blending with existing priors.
design:
Keep current staged candidate generation. Add online score as an additional ranking signal:
- final = α*model + β*log(frecency) + γ*sequence + δ*tier1
- confidence gating: if top1-top2 < margin or top1 < threshold, down-weight/skip model contribution

Feature flag it (config/env), default off until metrics are good.

Preserve Tier-1 invariants: prefix match, syntax validity, dedupe, workspace/cwd backoff.
acceptance_criteria:
Correctness
- No suggestions outside candidate set; Tier-1 constraints still enforced.
- With flag off: behavior identical to current.

Tests
- Add/extend predict tests to ensure gating prevents regressions on ambiguous scores.
- Add a scenario where online score reorders candidates but still respects prefix/workspace constraints.
- `mise test` passes.

title: Online model: prequential eval + leakage metrics
description: Add an offline evaluation harness for the online next-command model (rolling-window / prequential) with ranking + leakage metrics.
design:
Implement an eval command that replays shell_history chronologically:
- For each step: build ctx, generate candidate set (same pipeline), score with online model, record rank of true next command.
- Metrics: MRR@K, Recall@K, Coverage@K, context leakage rate (workspace/cwd mismatch).
- Support running with model disabled/enabled to compare.

Ensure evaluator can run deterministically against a fixed DB snapshot.
acceptance_criteria:
Metrics
- Produces MRR@K/Recall@K/Coverage@K + leakage on a sample history.
- Can run in CI on a small synthetic dataset.

Tests
- Add a small synthetic history fixture; assert metric expectations (e.g., MRR improves after training).
- Add a leakage regression test (never suggests unrelated workspace candidates above threshold).
- `mise test` passes.

title: Online model: trainer (negative sampling + replay)
description: Implement per-record online updates for next-command prediction using negative sampling, replay buffers, and stable optimizers.
design:
Implement online SGD updates on each ingested Invocation (or micro-batches).

Core
- Score(ctx, cmd) = dot(v_ctx, v_cmd) + optional biases
- Update using K negatives (mixed sampler Q) + log-Q correction
- Replay: 1 new + 1 global reservoir + 1 same-workspace ring (defaults from doc)
- Optimizer: Adagrad or RMSProp; include gradient clipping

Plumbing
- Hook into src/server.rs:flush_records after update_stats_for_invocation.
- Store/update model state in DB tables from schema issue.
acceptance_criteria:
Correctness
- Updates are transactional enough to survive crashes (at-most-once ok; no corrupt state).
- Trainer is deterministic given seed (where applicable).

Performance
- Average per-record update stays within budget (micro-batch allowed).

Tests
- Unit test: replay buffer behavior (reservoir + per-workspace ring).
- Unit test: negative sampler respects mixture weights and excludes positives.
- Integration test: record a small scripted history; verify model_score increases for observed transitions.
- `mise test` passes.
